anthony.name: Anthony Abbagnano
anthony.bio: A pioneer of breathwork with over 40 years of experience, and founder of Alchemy of Breath and ASHA. Known for his soul-level presence and ability to “see beyond the mask”, Anthony helps people navigate trauma, reconnect with their essence and meet life with courage and compassion.

amy.name: Amy Rachelle, ND
amy.bio: Amy bridges intuition with natural medicine. With over two decades of experience in fasting, plant-based nutrition and intuitive development, her sessions bring together emotional processing, naturopathic support and intuitive readings.

muji.name: Muji
muji.bio: A deeply attuned healer whose integrative approach combines somatic therapy, biodynamic craniosacral work and intuitive massage. Her sessions are spacious, restorative and finely tuned to the body’s inner rhythms.

michael.name: Michael Reiley
michael.bio: Composer, threshold musician and Deep Listening® facilitator, drawing on 25 years of practice from hospice bedsides to breathwork ceremonies. Handpan, crystal bowls, flutes and synthesis create a space where the body can release what words cannot reach.

monica.name: Monica Gentile
monica.bio: A movement artist and embodiment guide with over 30 years of experience in dance, yoga, martial arts and energy medicine, integrating dance, Hatha Yoga and Medical Qi Gong.

kate.name: Kate Hawley
kate.bio: A devoted energy healer with nearly 20 years of experience in Reiki, trained in three Reiki lineages, and an active teacher and leader within the Spanish Reiki Federation.

nancy.name: Nancy Iannotti
nancy.bio: A certified Breathwork Facilitator, Reiki Master and former Registered Nurse whose work bridges science, energy and embodied awareness, with a heart-centred, trauma-aware presence.
